name: Auth Page — can toggle between login and signup modes

planSteps.description: The login form is displayed with email and password fields
Click the link or button that contains 'إنشاء حساب' or 'حساب جديد' or 'التسجيل' to switch to signup mode
A full name input field is now visible on the page
An account type selector with options for 'شركة' (company) or 'باحث عن عمل' (job seeker) is visible
